We propose a new ED approach, using an encoder-decoder model. Given text and entity candidates, the encoder learns the interactions between the text and each entity candidate, generating representations for each candidate. Subsequently, the decoder fuses these candidate entity representations and generates correct entities.
outputs: entity titles (names) and their associated mention spans
The decoder fuses these candidate entity representations and generates correct entities. At inference, instead of relying on a constrained beam search, it only needs simple greedy decoding.
